info.title: Ark Rides API
info.description: Ride-hailing backend for Ark Rides: rider and driver identity (Privy + email), ride lifecycle, fare ledger, driver wallet, emergency SOS and off-app booking channels.

accessToken.description: Privy access token from the client SDK's getAccessToken().

identityToken.description: Privy identity token (the client's privy-id-token). Supplying it lets the server record the embedded wallet. Verified server-side, never trusted.

audience.description: Riders and drivers are separate accounts with separate id spaces, and one Privy DID may own one of each. The client states which it wants rather than the server guessing.

name.description: Used only when provisioning a brand-new rider.

refreshToken.description: The refresh token returned by sign-in.

phone.description: Nigerian mobile number, local or +234 form.

isOnline.description: true to receive ride requests, false to stop. Only approved, active drivers may go online.

reason.description: Shown to the driver when the application is rejected.

email.description: The email the driver registered with.
The email the reset OTP was sent to.

otp.description: The 6-digit code emailed by /drivers/forgot-password. Valid for 10 minutes.

driverId.description: Admin only. Drivers must omit this — the owner is taken from the access token.

pickup.description: The pickup location coordinates and address

dropoff.description: The destination location coordinates and address

estimatedFare.description: The calculated price for this ride

userId.description: Ignored for authenticated riders — the rider is taken from the access token.

category.description: The type of service requested (private = whole keke, shared = shared keke, okada = motorcycle, car = car)

rateeId.description: The UUID of the person being rated

rateeType.description: The type of the person being rated

resolutionNote.example: Contacted both parties, rider is safe

rawText.example: Book a car from FUTA to Market Square
rawText.description: The raw message, or the voice transcript

callerPhone.description: Caller identity. Used to find or create the rider account.

pickup.description: Pre-resolved pickup (e.g. a WhatsApp location pin). Preferred over geocoding the text.

dropoff.description: Pre-resolved dropoff, if the caller already has coordinates.

field.description: Dotted path to the offending property.

ApiFailureEnvelope.description: Returned for every 4xx and 5xx. `message` is ALWAYS a single string; field-level detail goes in `errors`.

message.example: You can only view your own ride history.

code.description: Machine-readable discriminator; branch on this, not on the message.

requestId.description: Present only on 5xx. Quote it when reporting a fault.

ApiSuccessEnvelope.description: Returned for every 2xx that carries a body.

data.description: The payload. Its shape is per-endpoint.
